CODE
3.75
Division 
Each co-owner may at any time demand the division of the property in incidental joint ownership. In accordance with Article 1561 of the Judicial Code, their creditors have the same right.
The co-owners may, however, agree to suspend partition for a period not exceeding five years. This agreement may be renewed and is enforceable against third parties subject to transcription in the registers of the relevant office of the General Administration of Heritage Documentation if any buildings are involved.
